title: A status a live blueprint uses can be removed when no ticket is in it; tickets then move into the removed status

panels.caption: TAVI API: removal accepted with no ticket in the state; a transition then sets the removed status; with a ticket inside, removal is refused
Zoho: Status is locked while the blueprint controls it; the strip shows the current state
TAVI ticket #1109 after the transition: Status "QA BP Verify" (locked, set by the blueprint) although it is no longer a ticket status
TAVI designer: "1 issue to fix before publishing · QA BP Verify is no longer a ticket status", yet the blueprint is still Active

rows: Removing a status a live blueprint uses

Status is locked inside a blueprint and changes only through its transitions. Deleting a status used by a blueprint is not described in Zoho help and was not tried in Zoho (it would change the Zoho org).
With no ticket in that state, removing "QA BP Verify" is accepted (200) and the blueprint stays active. With a ticket inside, it is refused (422 FIELD_OPTION_IN_BLUEPRINT), which is correct.
A ticket runs the transition into that state
The ticket stays on a valid status.
Ticket #1109 moves into "QA BP Verify": Status shows it (locked, "Set by blueprint QA BP C20c") although it is no longer a ticket status.
The designer shows "QA BP Verify is no longer a ticket status" as an issue to fix before publishing, but the published version stays Active and keeps moving tickets there.
